# Observe & perf

Traces of every turn and tool call, an activity log, a browser preview of dev servers, process memory, and hot reload that waits for idle.

Pack id `observe`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/traces`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/traces/README.md) — Local OTLP/HTTP trace receiver and viewer: trace list, span waterfall, operation stats and error groups inside DSH.
2. [`@dshfiles/activity-timeline`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/activity-timeline/README.md) — Unified chronological activity timeline across agents, sessions, communication, and jj workspaces.
3. [`@dshfiles/preview`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/preview/README.md) — Agent browser tools over a Host-managed headless Chromium scoped per thread, and the dev servers each thread started.
4. [`@dshfiles/hmr-gate`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/hmr-gate/README.md) — Web client HMR transport that only announces a rebuilt plugin while its Host half is the code the running Host loaded.
5. [`@dshfiles/worktree-memory`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/worktree-memory/README.md) — Resident memory of DSH process trees by workspace and deterministic origins for current-user Node processes.

## Prerequisites

None.

## Key settings

1. **Where traces are stored**: Settings entry `dshfiles-traces`, field `mode`.
2. **Hosts the preview browser may open**: Settings entry `dshfiles-preview`, field `allowedHosts`.

## Features

From the onboarding feature catalog: 34 features, the 22 curated ones first.

### Curated

1. **Trace list and span waterfall** (`traces`, observe) — List traces with filters, and open one as a timeline of its spans.
2. **Traces tab in the thread panel** (`traces`, thread-panel) — The thread panel's Traces tab shows only this thread's traces.
3. **Log search with trace correlation** (`traces`, observe) — Search stored logs and open the trace each one belongs to.
4. **Service and operation overview, error groups** (`traces`, observe) — See volume, errors and latency per service and operation, and group errors by kind.
5. **Service dependency map** (`traces`, observe) — A map of services and the calls between them, with failing calls in red.
6. **Metric list with one chart per metric** (`traces`, observe) — List every metric per service and chart the one you pick.
7. **Alert rules over stored telemetry** (`traces`, inbox) — Set alert rules on error rate, latency or volume, checked every minute.
8. **Boards and saved views** (`traces`, observe) — Built-in boards show slow tools, failing plugins and model latency, and you can save your own views.
9. **Span ↔ transcript links** (`traces`, transcript) — Open a span in its thread, scrolled to the turn or tool call it belongs to.
10. **List-price cost on traces** (`traces`, thread-panel) — Traces show what each thread, turn and model call cost at list price.
11. **Firing alerts in the Inbox** (`traces`, inbox) — A firing alert shows in the Inbox with its value, threshold and window.
12. **Activity feed** (`activity-timeline`, observe) — One feed of thread, agent and workspace events, with search and filters.
13. **Grouped activity, errors kept visible** (`activity-timeline`, inbox) — Routine events fold into groups, while errors and items that need you stay on their own row.
14. **Check results in the activity feed** (`activity-timeline`, observe) — See each project check's result in the activity feed and open the thread it ran for.
15. **One attention inbox for everything that needs you** (`activity-timeline`, inbox) — Everything that needs you lands in one inbox that you and the agent can mark done, snooze or mute.
16. **Inbox page with one Needs you badge** (`activity-timeline`, inbox) — The Inbox page lists what needs you, one action per row, with a single badge on its rail icon.
17. **Open an Inbox item's source in one click** (`activity-timeline`, inbox) — Each Inbox row opens the thread or page it is about in one click.
18. **Push blocking Inbox items to a device** (`activity-timeline`, inbox) — Get a notification on this device when something needs you, even when DSH is not open.
19. **Answer a subagent's question in its parent thread** (`activity-timeline`, transcript) — A subagent's question shows above its parent thread's composer, so you can answer it there.
20. **Agent preview browser** (`preview`, thread-panel) — The agent drives its own browser for each thread to open, click, type and take screenshots.
21. **Thread dev servers** (`preview`, thread-panel) — The thread header lists the ports its processes serve, to open each one or stop it.
22. **Agent browser** (`preview`, thread-panel) — The Agent browser tab shows the page the agent is driving, and you can click and type in it.

### More

1. **Built-in trace receiver** (`traces`) — DSH receives traces from any OpenTelemetry exporter on this machine and keeps them.
2. **Browser interaction traces** (`traces`) — Slow clicks in the page, such as switching threads, record traces down to the work they caused.
3. **DSH stalls** (`traces`) — Each time DSH froze for more than 100 ms is recorded with the work that was running.
4. **Span store space and Reclaim** (`traces`) — See how much space the trace store uses and give free space back to the disk.
5. **Offline HTML screenshots for other plugins** (`preview`) — Other features can take a screenshot of an HTML page in an offline browser.
6. **Plugin updates waiting for a restart** (`hmr-gate`) — The Plugins page lists plugin updates that wait for a DSH restart, and the page keeps working meanwhile.
7. **Plugin updates waiting for a restart in the Inbox** (`hmr-gate`, inbox) — The Inbox shows one item naming plugin updates that wait for a restart, and when to restart.
8. **Waiting updates join the restart notice** (`hmr-gate`) — Plugin updates that need a restart are named in the one Restart pending item in the status bar.
9. **Reload a plugin without restarting DSH** (`hmr-gate`) — Off by default: a plugin marked safe can reload inside the running DSH without a restart.
10. **Plugin updates wait for a hidden or idle moment** (`hmr-gate`) — Plugin updates apply only when the page is hidden or you have been idle for a while.
11. **Process RAM** (`worktree-memory`, observe) — The RAM tab of Processes shows how much memory DSH and other Node processes use, by workspace.
12. **Leftover test copies of DSH** (`worktree-memory`, observe) — Test copies of DSH left running are listed with their memory, and Stop orphans ends them.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Observe & perf under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `observe`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs observe` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
